The need is especially acute in [priority neighborhoods or communities], where [local condition or barrier] makes it harder to [access a service or achieve a desired outcome]. This proposal focuses on [target population] because [local evidence showing why this group faces a disproportionate burden or has fewer options].

**Local scale and impact.** According to [local data source, year, table or page], [number] of [denominator] [residents, households, or students] in [service area] experienced [problem] in [year], a rate of [X]%, compared with [Y]% in [county/state or comparable area] ([benchmark source, year]). The burden is not evenly distributed: in [priority neighborhood or subgroup], [X]% experienced [problem], compared with [Y]% across [broader area] ([source, year]). [Second local source, year] documents a related consequence: [statistic showing how the problem affects the population]. Together, these figures show both how widespread the problem is and where its effects are concentrated.

**Why the need is urgent.** The latest figures are not an isolated snapshot. Between [earlier year] and [most recent year], [consistent local indicator] changed from [baseline value] to [current value], a [change in percentage points or counts] over [number] years ([source, years]). [Explain what the trend shows: the problem is worsening, has remained persistently high, or has improved overall while a specific group continues to face a gap.] In [most recent year], [recent local evidence, such as referral volume, unmet requests, or changes in service availability] showed [specific finding] ([source, year]). For [target population], the practical consequence is [what happens when assistance is delayed or unavailable].

**Where existing services fall short.** [Local providers or agencies] currently offer [relevant services], but [target population] still faces [specific capacity or access barrier]. In [time period], [provider or referral network] recorded [number] requests for [service] and was able to serve [number] ([source, year]). [Add one documented measure of the gap, such as median wait time, the share of referrals not completed, or the distance to the nearest provider.] Even when services are available, [documented barrier involving hours, cost, transportation, language, or eligibility] can prevent [target population] from using them. For example, [brief, verified local example showing how the barrier plays out]. The gap this proposal addresses is therefore specific: [who] cannot reliably access [what service] [where or when they need it].

**What residents told us.** In [month/year], [organization or partner] heard from [number] [residents, participants, or caregivers] through [survey, listening sessions, or interviews]. Participants described [recurring barrier] and identified [specific change] as a priority. [Insert a brief, permission-cleared quote or an unattributed paraphrase that illustrates the barrier.] Their feedback clarified what the service data alone could not: [specific insight about why people cannot use existing services or what would make those services usable]. ## Outcomes & Objectives

The program will address [documented need] among [target population] in [service area]. As described in the Statement of Need, [specific barrier] makes it difficult for participants to [access a service or achieve a desired result]. Over the [duration]-month grant period, we will measure whether participants gain timely access to [service], improve [primary participant outcome], and sustain that improvement after services end.

**Objective 1: Improve timely access to [service].** By [end of Year 1/date], at least [target %] of eligible referrals will result in a first completed [appointment, session, or service] within [number] calendar days of referral, up from [baseline %] during [baseline period]. We will calculate this rate using referral and service dates recorded in [referral log or case management system]. The denominator will include all eligible referrals whose [number]-day window has elapsed, including those who did not receive service. This objective directly addresses the [wait time or referral gap] documented in the Statement of Need.

**Objective 2: Improve [primary participant outcome].** By [date], at least [target %] of enrolled participants due for an exit assessment will demonstrate [defined improvement, such as a gain of at least X points on a named scale] from intake to exit. At intake, participants’ average [indicator] is [baseline score and scale, if available]; the baseline rate of participants achieving the defined improvement is [baseline % from a comparable prior cohort, if available]. Staff will administer [assessment tool] at intake and within [number] days of exit. We will report assessment completion separately and count only documented improvements toward the target.

**Objective 3: Sustain gains after services end.** By [date], at least [target %] of participants who met Objective 2 and are due for follow-up will still meet [specific threshold for sustained improvement] at [30/90/180] days after exit, compared with [baseline % from a comparable prior cohort, if available]. Staff will verify the result through [follow-up assessment, administrative record, or partner confirmation] and report the follow-up completion rate alongside it.

If historical data are unavailable, we will use [first cohort or initial reporting period] to establish the missing baseline using the same measure and timing specified above. We will distinguish an intake baseline from a historical rate of improvement; they answer different questions.

**Outputs vs. outcomes.** Outputs show what we deliver: [number] participants enrolled, [number] sessions delivered, and [number] referrals made. Outcomes show what changes: participants receive services sooner, improve on [primary indicator], and maintain that improvement after exit.

## Evaluation Plan

We will use a pre/post design to assess whether [target population] receives [service] sooner, improves on [primary outcome], and maintains that improvement after exit. For timely access, we will compare the share of eligible referrals that result in a completed first service within [number] days with the rate during [baseline period], using the same eligibility rules and time window. For participant outcomes, we will compare intake and exit scores on [assessment tool] and assess whether participants who improved still meet [threshold] at [number]-day follow-up. [If applicable: Describe the comparison group, how it will be selected or matched, and which measures and time periods will be comparable.] Without a credible comparison group, we will report changes observed during participation without attributing them solely to the program.

| Timing | Data collected and source |
|---|---|
| **Referral and intake** | [Referral log] captures referral date, eligibility, and first completed service date. [Intake form] records participant characteristics, and [assessment tool] establishes the individual starting score before services begin. |
| **Midpoint ([week/month])** | [Service records] track attendance and services received; [brief check-in tool] identifies engagement barriers and tracks interim progress. |
| **Exit (within [number] days)** | Staff repeat [assessment tool], record completion status, and collect participant feedback through [survey or interview tool]. |
| **Follow-up ([number] days after exit)** | Staff use [follow-up tool or approved records] to assess whether gains were sustained and log contact attempts and missing responses. |

[Frontline staff role/name] will collect data at each scheduled point. [Data lead role/name] will check records monthly for missing assessments, duplicate entries, and inconsistent dates. [Internal evaluation lead or external evaluator, name/role] will analyze results against the baselines and targets in the Outcomes & Objectives section. Reports will show who was due for each assessment, who completed it, and how missing results were handled so that response rates are visible alongside outcomes.

[Program manager and team] will review access and participation data monthly and outcome trends quarterly. If timely access falls below [threshold], the team will review referral handoffs and appointment availability. If assessment completion or participant progress falls below [threshold], the team will examine barriers, assign a corrective action and an owner, and check progress at the next review.

Data will be stored in [approved secure system] with role-based access, encryption, and unique participant IDs. Identifiers will be stored separately from analysis files. Staff will explain what is collected, how it will be used, and any consent requirements. External reports will use aggregate data and suppress small cells where disclosure could identify participants. Records will be retained and securely deleted according to [retention policy and applicable requirements].
